vorobev-sindikat.title: Vorobyov Syndicate
vorobev-sindikat.summary: Scrolling carries the visitor from an apartment fuse box to a factory floor, with a price guide at every step — the company's scale is clear without a word.
vorobev-sindikat.description: The hero is one continuous camera flight: an apartment, wiring inside the wall, a private house, an office, a workshop and the city at night from above, with captions and prices changing in sync with the frame. Phones get a dedicated vertical film, so the journey holds up on a small screen. Below: photos from real sites, a cost calculator, client reviews and a free on-site estimate by phone or email.
highlights: a dedicated vertical film for phones
price scales with the size of the job

autojoker.title: AutoJoker
autojoker.summary: Instead of a home page, a garage: the visitor opens the door, picks a part of the car and sees exactly what will be repaired.
autojoker.description: The site plays like a garage game: the door opens with a gesture, the car rolls out under the lamps, and seven buttons — engine, suspension, body, electrics, tyres, diagnostics and paint — launch their own breakdown scenes. A gas pedal and tachometer let you rev the engine and send the car out of the yard, while paint mode tries on body colors. Below, over a scroll-driven drift, come services, an award and rating, reviews, vacancies and repair booking.
highlights: a garage instead of a home page

mollstroy.title: Moll Stroy
mollstroy.summary: A country house on screen comes apart into materials, and every layer leads to a priced catalog — buyers work out the volume themselves and order with one call.
mollstroy.description: The header is a film in which the house comes apart layer by layer into block house siding, wind barrier, insulation, boards and beams, with a price card and a catalog link popping up for each layer. The catalog holds 42 products and 199 priced sizes, the calculator covers every material group, and ordering takes one call — no cart, forms or sign-up. On phones, scenes swipe, and "Catalog", "Estimate" and "Call" are always under your thumb.
highlights: the house comes apart into materials on scroll

alarm-sistem.title: ALARM SISTEM
alarm-sistem.summary: The visitor pulls the cover off the car, picks the protection and sees the installed price before ever calling.
alarm-sistem.description: The hero works like a showroom reveal: one motion pulls the cloth off the car, uncovering a panel of six services, each with its own short film. Below: a catalog of alarms, immobilizers and parking sensors with equipment and turnkey prices, a labor price list and straight answers to common questions. A starfield drifts beneath the content, responding to scroll and cursor.
highlights: the car cover comes off in one gesture
catalog with equipment and installation prices
starfield background reacts to scroll and cursor

autospec-nn.title: AvtospecNN
autospec-nn.summary: The car on screen comes apart as you scroll and reassembles by the contacts — clients see a shop that finds the cause instead of swapping parts at random.
autospec-nn.description: One film runs beneath the entire page: by the middle the car is stripped down to its components, by the end it's whole again, and short lines — "Understanding the problem", "Finding the cause", "Done right" — sit in different corners of the frame. On top: diagnostics, engine, suspension and brake services, a before/after slider and a large phone number at the finale. On phones the page loads fast: a still frame replaces the film.
highlights: the car comes apart and back together on scroll

avtoakademia.title: AvtoAkademia
avtoakademia.summary: Before signing up, a future student rides the whole path — from the first lesson on the training lot to driving in the city — in a scroll-driven film.
avtoakademia.description: The scroll film runs from the training lot to city streets: no experience, theory, first drive, maneuvers and city practice, each stage with its own caption. License categories come alive in short videos, "Five steps to your license" can be driven by holding a button, and prices, installment plans and eight branches on a map sit on one page. Phones get a separate vertical edit, and the school's official accreditation details live on their own page.
highlights: scroll video from training lot to city
a short video for each license category
"Five steps to your license" route, driven by holding a button
prices, installments and 8 branches on a map
